title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode7 Let's Have Fun Together

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Strike zone?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's the game where you throw baseballs at a board with number panels on it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think I've seen that before.
Getting the ball to hit each panel's supposed to feel pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it also seems really difficult since you need good arm control...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, Kanade, you went out of your way to recommend it, so I'd like to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we can try it together!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, Kanade, I didn't expect you to choose something like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does this mean you like baseball...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know the rules very well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When I was little, there was a facility like this near my house, and I remember playing strike zone there with my dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He taught me how to throw the ball that time and I even managed to win some juice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had so much fun that I was hoping to try it again someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, for Kanade's sake, we absolutely have to win the grand prize for getting a perfect score!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The grand prize?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it was written in the pamphlet! If you get a perfect score, you win a free pass to PXL! You can also win some juice for each bingo you get!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... That does make things more interesting. A perfect score's probably out of the question, but a bingo sounds doable...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm really not sure how well I'm going to do since it's been so long...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But we get to do this together, so I should try to have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We get a total of twelve balls, so that's three apiece... How about we switch out each time we throw a pitch?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Got it!
Alright, who's gonna lead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me! I'd like to go first!
I'll start us off on the right foot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now pitching... Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hold and... Throw!
se_event_sports_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa! So fast!
se_event_sports_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th-That's incredible. She got one on her first try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But in the other lane...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The other lane... That's sort of a miracle in its own way... It's very you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooo... I couldn't do it...
Ichika, save us...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay, I'll try...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright... Here goes nothing!
se_event_sports_2022_004
se_event_sports_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-It's in! I got #5!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nice one, Ichika! That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And she nailed the one in the center.
As long as we hit any of the other ones, we'll be one step away from getting a bingo.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was really impressive, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm next.
I need to keep the wave Ichika created going.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here we go...!
se_event_sports_2022_004
se_event_sports_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?! I totally hit it, right?!
Why isn't it saying that I did? Is the machine broken?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's because you hit the outer frame. That might be why it believes you didn't get it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! I so thought I got it just now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was a good try, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Grr... That's so frustrating...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's okay! You'll get it next time, so hang in there, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're next, Kanade.
Good luck.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I haven't done this since I tried it with Dad all those years ago...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think he started by showing me how to actually throw the ball.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (You're supposed to grip it using three fingers...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Pull your elbow back, step using your foot on the opposite side and... Throw!)
se_event_sports_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
Kanade, your pitch...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's slowly arcing...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it bounced in front of the panels...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
...
I'm sorry, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's okay, Kanade!
It's still your first pitch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And your form was so pretty!
I'm sure you'll hit it after some fine-tuning!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it's actually pretty far to the panels, so you sort of have to get a better feel for how to gauge the distance. I mean, that's what I'll need to do as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I just need to get a better feel for things!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your issue seems to be on a different level compared to us, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I'll do my best to hit it next time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, round two!
I'm absolutely gonna get it right this time!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: With all my might... Here goes pitch number twooo!
se_event_sports_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori, if you throw it that hard...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... It hit the wall...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Why?!
I'm so sorry, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our last pitch... With you closing it out for us, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I thought we had this in the bag after we got #5 during our first go-around...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But Ichika hit #1, so we can still get a bingo as long as we hit #9!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aiming for a specific spot seems easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So much pressure...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just try to relax, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Don't worry about trying to win a prize.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It'd be nice if we won, but more than anything, we're here to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Kanade, give it everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I will...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Having fun is more important...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why... Even if it's just for now, I want you to smile!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I don't think I'm alone.
I believe Ena, Ichika and everyone in your group feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I didn't think I had any time to have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But if that's what'll make them happy...
I should enjoy the time I have with them.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And recall exactly what Dad taught me that day...)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, Daddy, you're so good at hitting the panels! You got three already!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. I just got lucky.
Oh, Kanade, why don't you give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Really?
Even though you're just one away from getting a bingo?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I can't throw the ball as well as you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I'll teach you, so you'll be fine.
Here, let's move a little closer towards the panels.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Alright, you grip the ball like this using three fingers.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Like this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That's right. Once you have a good grip, pull your elbow back, step using your foot on the opposite side and throw.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay!
Pull your elbow back, step and... Throw!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh no! I missed...
I couldn't get it to go straight like you, Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. It's your first time, so don't worry. I wasn't very good in the beginning either.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: But, Kanade, there's actually a little trick to throwing the ball straight.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: A little trick?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: A good rhythm is a vital part of the throwing motion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: If your hands and feet aren't in sync, you won't be able to throw the ball very far or straight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Why don't you try throwing while counting out loud by saying, “One, two, three”...?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: One, two, three... Throw!
se_event_sports_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow... I hit it!
Daddy, I hit it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
That's incredible, Kanade!
Can you do that for me one more time?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right. My hands and feet have to be in sync for me to get the ball to go anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One, two, three... One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Throwing a ball's just like music... My body needs to stay in rhythm...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One, two... Throw!
se_event_sports_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that pitch looked really good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it's going straight! As long as it reaches the panel...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Go!!
se_event_sports_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I hit it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: #9 too... Hang on. That means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay!
Kanade, bingo!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-Hanasato...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Kanade!
I can't believe you actually got it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My heart was racing just now...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
I can't believe it either...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad that I managed to succeed in the end...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really appreciate the support you all gave me. Again, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm really glad too. I don't think I've ever seen you smile like this before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...
